annotations.text:
SSK AI Hub landing — desktop (1440) and mobile (390), built from the shipped design system (tokens.css, ssk-hub.css, components.css).
Use the Dark tweak above each artboard to preview the dark theme.

OPTION A — BROADSHEET (recommended)
By-the-book editorial front page in your existing design language: 8/4-column grid, lead edition as the dominant element, numbered story rail with hairline rules, dated archive river.
Motivation: strongest hierarchy with zero new ingredients — drops straight into the current site.
Tradeoff: the most conventional of the three.
Has a Dark tweak.

OPTION B — SERIF EDITION
Same front-page skeleton, but headlines in a high-contrast serif (Newsreader) on a warm paper ground, centered nameplate, flattened hairline header.
Motivation: reads most like a real publication; gives Tech News its own identity inside the hub.
Tradeoff: introduces a second typeface and a warmer ground that diverge from the rest of the site.

OPTION C — WIRE DESK
Poster-like navy edition band with reversed type for the current edition, then a dense two-column numbered wire index below.
Motivation: maximum front-page impact and the most distinctive of the three.
Tradeoff: boldest departure from the restrained hairline register; heavy ink in dark contexts.
